units.source_text: 母狗走了以后，小宠犬在廊道上一边嗅着气味儿一边走，它用前足的爪子挠客厅的门扉。

en.t: After the female dog had gone, the little pet dog walked along the corridor sniffing at the scent, and scratched at the parlor door with the claws of its front paws.

units.source_text: 夫人粗暴地一把将它抱了起来，又坐在镜子前面。

en.t: The lady roughly snatched it up in her arms and sat down in front of the mirror again.

units.source_text: 深夜丈夫回来的时候，夫人也还是在面对着镜子。

en.t: When her husband came home late that night, the lady was still facing the mirror.
